checks.scenario: Install the signed non-debuggable release APK; verify package, positive version code, signing certificate, target SDK 36 or higher, and 16 KB ELF/ZIP alignment compatibility; launch without a crash.
Upgrade the previous installed version; verify saved workspace, preferences and authenticated session migrate correctly.
Cold start, force stop and relaunch; verify startup recovery and no duplicate initialization.
Exercise every primary screen, hardware Back, gestures, rotation and edge-to-edge safe areas.
Enter long text and numeric values; verify keyboard does not hide fields or save actions.
Lose network during reads and writes; reconnect and verify clear errors, retry and no duplicate records.
Background and resume during a save; kill and restart after saving; verify persisted results.
Grant, deny and permanently deny camera access; capture an invoice and recover without losing the form.
Grant and deny microphone permission; interrupt voice capture and verify safe retry and cancellation.
Test denied, approximate and precise location with clock-in; verify review behavior and no incorrect punch.
Grant and deny notification permission; verify settings link, graceful fallback and no repeated prompts.
Deliver a reminder while backgrounded and closed; tap it, edit/cancel it, and confirm no stale duplicates.
Generate, open, print and share PDFs; cancel external activities and return with app state intact.
Sign out and switch accounts/workspaces; verify Back and offline caches do not expose prior private records.
Use TalkBack and large font/display scaling; verify focus, labels, contrast, scrolling and touch targets.
Open supported deep links; exercise low-memory resume and a long active session; inspect crash/ANR and resource logs.
